steps.code:
# Found "Tangled Lies" by Ava Morgan with release_date "2022-12-11T06:22:44" → month 12/2022.
# Now let me search for all remaining songs in a loop and collect their release dates.

songs_to_search = [
    ("Lost in the Wilderness of Love", "Lily Moon"),
    ("Whispers of a Forgotten Love", "Lily Moon"),
    ("Lost in the Twilight of Hope", "Felix Blackwood"),
    ("The Distance Between Two Hearts", "Jasper Skye"),
    ("When All Hope Seems Lost", "Seraphina Dawn"),
    ("The Forgotten Pages of Time", "Luna Starlight"),
    ("Summer's End", "Ethan Wallace"),
    ("A Tale of Unspoken Longing", "Emily Rivers"),
    ("Cracks in the Facade of Love", "Velvet Echo"),
    ("A Fading Reflection in Water", "Lucas Grey"),
    ("Trapped in a Daydream", "Nova Harmony"),
    ("Mystic Voyage to Avalon", "Nova Harmony"),
]

release_months = {}
release_months["Tangled Lies — Ava Morgan"] = "12/2022"

for title, artist in songs_to_search:
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, page_limit=5)
    for song in results:
        if song['title'] == title and any(a['name'] == artist for a in song['artists']):
            release_date = song['release_date']  # format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS
            month = release_date[5:7]
            year = release_date[0:4]
            release_months[f"{title} — {artist}"] = f"{month}/{year}"
            break
    else:
        release_months[f"{title} — {artist}"] = "NOT FOUND"

print(release_months)
